claim: The minimum alcohol demanded there is the highest of any French appellation.
because: The 12.5% key is correct: the Chateauneuf-du-Pape cahier des charges sets a titre alcoometrique volumique naturel minimum of 12.5%. But it is not the highest in France. The Gigondas cahier des charges sets the same 12.5% minimum, so it is at best shared. Sweet appellations such as Sauternes demand far higher minimum natural potential alcohol. A candidate who learns the stem as written learns a false superlative.
fix: The minimum natural alcohol demanded there, among the highest set for any French dry wine appellation, is what?
